Here’s a classic recipe‑style ingredient list you’ll need to make a hearty lasagna: | Category | Typical Ingredients | |----------|---------------------| | **Lasagna noodles** | • Regular or no‑boil sheets (about 9–12 pieces)
• Optional: whole wheat or gluten‑free varieties | | **Meat sauce** | • Ground beef or Italian sausage (½ lb per pound of pasta)
• Onion, finely chopped
• Garlic cloves, minced
• Crushed tomatoes or tomato passata (~2 cups)
• Tomato paste (1 tbsp)
• Olive oil (for sautéing)
• Salt & pepper to taste
• Dried oregano, basil, thyme (¼ tsp each)
• Red wine splash (optional) | | **Ricotta layer** | • Ricotta cheese (1 cup)
• Egg (1, beaten – helps bind)
• Grated Parmesan (¼ cup)
• Fresh parsley or basil, chopped (1 Tbsp)
• Pinch salt & nutmeg | | **Mozzarella topping** | • Shredded mozzarella (2 cups)
• Extra shredded mozzarella on top (½ cup) | | **Optional extras** | • Sautéed spinach or kale (½ cup), wilted
• Cooked mushrooms (½ cup)
• Roasted red peppers (½ cup)
• Sun-dried tomatoes (¼ cup) | | **Seasoning mix** | • Additional dried herbs if desired (oregano, basil, rosemary) | ### Quick Prep Tips: * If using regular lasagna sheets, pre-cook them until al dente before layering—no‑boil sheets skip this step. * For extra flavor, brown your meat first then add onions/garlic only after it’s cooked through. * Mix ricotta with egg and seasonings so it stays moist during baking. Enjoy building layers! Let me know if you'd like a full step-by-step guide or variations such as vegetarian or vegan options.
